title: CULTURAL PROGRAMMES ENRICH BRAHMOTSAVAMS IN TIRUPATI _ తిరుపతిలో బ్రహ్మోత్సవాల సాంస్కృతిక శోభ
article_text:
byTTD News•Brahmotsavams,Featured,General News

Tirupati, September 21, 2026 ; TTD organised devotional, spiritual and cultural programmes in Tirupati on Monday as part of the Srivari Brahmotsavams.

Devotional music and Bharatanatyam were presented at Mahati Auditorium and Annamacharya Kalamandiram. A Harikatha performance was also held at Ramachandra Pushkarini.

The programmes were organised by TTD’s Hindu Dharma Prachara Parishad, Dasa Sahitya Project, Annamacharya Project and SV College of Music and Dance.

ISSUED BY THE TTD CHIEF PUBLIC RELATIONS OFFICER
